preconditions.description: The length of both words s and t do not exceed 100 symbols.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in s) and all(c.islower() for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both words s and t consist of lowercase Latin letters only.
The words s and t are not the same.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the word t is the word s written reversely, otherwise output 'NO'.
